item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las me ngag zhal shes
item.coloph: dpal gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud/ phyag cha las kyi 'khor lo la/ man ngag bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud pa yi/ man ngag sde tshan bzhi po 'di/ yi ger btab pa'i thal med pa'i/ gcig rgyud snyan du byos par mdzod/ 'di med phyag cha dbyugs kyang / stang chen thugs kyi dkyil du zhog ces gsungs so/ zhal shes kyi man ngag yi ger btab pas/ ma gcig bka' gsang lha mo dang / bka' nyan ma gshin btsan bdud dang / rgyud srung tshogs la bzod par gsol/ blo ldan snying po'i snyan du brgyud do//
